name: Account Management Type 2 Code
definition: Refer to an account management instruction ie, either an account opening instruction or an account modification instruction or a get account details message.

ACCO.name: Account Opening
ACCO.definition: Refers to an account opening instruction message.

ACCM.name: Account Modification
ACCM.definition: Refers to an account modification instruction message.

GACC.name: Get Account Details
GACC.definition: Refers to a get account details message.
